title: Android: get your Costco receipt as a PDF

vo.text: On Android? Get your Costco receipt as a PDF.
In your browser, open costco.ca. Tap Account, then Orders and Purchases.
Open the warehouse tab, and view the receipt.
Tap Print Receipt, choose Save as PDF, then Save.
In PriceBack, tap Upload file, and pick the PDF from Downloads.
On an iPhone? Watch our iPhone version.
